comments:
26d54a0c:  .;
 .;Set entry points for parameters for Integrated Registration
 .;Transcription (IRT) software functionality.
 .;
 .;Variables:
 .;DIC  ^DG(40.8 is the global root where the IRT Parameters file
 .;      is stored (#40.8)
 .;DIC(0) Sets parameters for FileMan lookup/add code
 .;        A - LAYGO (Learn As You Go) add new entries
 .;        E - Echo information
 .;        M - Menu mode
 .;        Q - Quit after user enters up-arrow
 .;
2fb2b4bc: Call FileMan lookup/add routine ^DIC. If no entry is selected, quit.
c854066a: Open FileMan data entry routine ^DIE to edit the selected IRT Parameters entry using the DGJ IRT PARAMETERS input template. DIE is global root, DA is IEN, DR is input template name.
3a4d6bef: Clean up variables and quit routine.
